data.name: Parvinder
data.gender_notes: Parvinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parvatindra, Parvat means mountain and Indra means lord. The name Parvinder is derived from Lord Shiva, who is known to be the king of mountains and the god of destruction. The name Parvinder carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Hindi. Parents who choose Parvinder usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents strength, power, and destruction, as well as a connection to nature and the divine.
data.etymology: Parvinder belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parvinder total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Parvinder is rooted in Hindu mythology, reflecting the legacy of India’s rich cultural history. It signifies power, strength, and unwavering devotion, as Lord Shiva, like a mighty mountain, symbolizes these qualities. It connects us to our heritage, instilling a sense of pride in our identity.
data.spiritual_significance: Parvinder signifies the internal strength and power that we all possess, reminding us that we too can navigate through life’s challenges, just like Lord Shiva did. It evokes the spiritual attributes of inner calm and resilience, emphasizing the importance of staying grounded in difficult times. It encourages devotion, selflessness, and the pursuit of inner peace, as we follow the footsteps of the great Hindu deity that this name is inspired by.
